title: Venus: why you fall
in love with love.
summary: What Venus does when she sits in the part of your chart that holds marriage and partners: the gift, the catch, how it changes by rising sign, and who has her there in the sky right now.

intro: Some people treat love as one part of life. If Venus sits in your seventh house, love tends to be the story itself. Partners, marriage, the person across the table: this is where your life is read to bloom, and where most of your lessons come from too.

This guide explains what the tradition reads from the placement, what it gives, where it trips people up, and how it changes depending on your rising sign. At the end there is a short note on who has Venus passing through their house of partners in the sky right now.

sections.label: The planet
title: The best-dressed
guest.
paragraphs: In Vedic astrology Venus, called Shukra, is the planet of love, beauty, pleasure, art and comfort. She is the natural significator of the spouse, especially in a man’s chart, and of romance and harmony in everyone’s. She rules two signs, Taurus and Libra, is read as at her finest in Pisces and as weaker in Virgo.

Think of her as the guest who arrives beautifully dressed, notices the flowers, and makes everyone in the room feel a little more attractive. Wherever she sits in your chart is where life is read to be softer, more pleasant and more charming.

sections.label: The room
title: Room seven:
the other person.
paragraphs: Your chart is a house of twelve rooms, counted from your rising sign. The seventh room is the one directly opposite you. It holds the people you meet one to one.

items.name: Marriage and partners
items.text: The spouse, long relationships, and what you look for in the person you commit to.

items.name: Business partners
items.text: Anyone you deal with as an equal: a co-founder, a client, an agent.

items.name: The public
items.text: How you meet people out in the world, and how they meet you.

items.name: A charming partner
items.text: Venus here is read as a partner with charm, good looks or real taste: someone who dresses well, decorates well, or simply makes life more beautiful.

items.name: Ease with people
items.text: People with this placement are read as warm, diplomatic and easy to like. Relationships tend to form without much effort, and you often know how to keep the peace.

items.name: Marriage as a big theme
items.text: Partnership is read as central to life. Many people with this placement feel most themselves when they are part of a pair.

items.name: Good partnerships at work
items.text: The same grace helps in business: negotiating, selling, working with clients and anything that runs on goodwill.

items.name: Falling for the feeling
items.text: Because love comes easily, it is easy to fall for the feeling of being in love rather than the person. A beautiful beginning can hide a poor fit.

items.name: Losing yourself
items.text: The partner can become the centre of everything, and your own friends, interests and plans slowly fade. Classical texts also note that a planet sitting in the very house it signifies can be read as too much of a good thing.

items.name: Comfort over growth
items.text: Venus prefers harmony. With her here, it can be tempting to avoid a hard conversation to keep things pleasant.

sections.label: By rising sign
title: Your seventh room,
sign by sign.
paragraphs: The sign on your seventh room depends on your rising sign. Venus is read differently in each: strongest where she rules or is exalted, gentler where she is weaker. Find your rising sign on the left.

rows.note: Her own sign. Read as the classic placement: a graceful, balanced partner.
Intense, private love. Deep loyalty, strong feelings.
A partner who loves ideas, travel and freedom.
Steady, practical love that grows over time.
Her exalted sign. Read as tender, devoted and generous love.
Passionate and quick to start. Patience helps it last.
Her own sign. Read as comfortable, loyal and sensual love.
Playful, talkative love. A partner who is fun to be with.
Caring, homely love. Family matters a great deal.
Warm, generous and a little dramatic. Love likes to be seen.
A sign where she is read as weaker: love shown through care and small acts.

sections.label: What helps
title: Love big, keep
a room of your own.
paragraphs: The usual advice is not to love less but to stay whole while you do it.

steps.name: Keep your own friends
steps.text: Make plans that have nothing to do with your partner, and keep them. A full life makes you a better partner, not a distant one.

steps.name: Keep your own fun
steps.text: One hobby, one evening a week, one thing that is only yours. It is the simplest guard against losing yourself.

steps.name: Give a beginning time
steps.text: When something feels perfect in week one, wait a few months before big promises. If it is real, it will still be there.

steps.name: Have the hard conversation
steps.text: Harmony that skips every difficult talk is fragile. Venus here is read as good at saying hard things kindly, so use that.

sections.label: Right now
title: Venus in the sky
this season.
paragraphs: Separately from your birth chart, Venus is moving through the sky. From November 22 2026 until New Year’s Day she is in Libra, her own sign, which is the seventh sign from an Aries Moon: Aries Moon people have the planet of love walking through their house of partners, and the tradition reads it as a sweet stretch for relationships.
On January 1 2027 she moves into Scorpio, the seventh sign from a Taurus Moon, and on January 29 into Sagittarius, the seventh from a Gemini Moon. She moves forward the whole time.

faq.q: How do I know if my Venus is in the seventh house?
faq.a: From your birth chart. The houses depend on your rising sign, which changes about every two hours, so you need your time of birth. Draw your chart on the home page and it is shown straight away.

faq.q: Does Venus in the seventh mean I will have a happy marriage?
faq.a: It is read as a placement that favours love and partnership, but no single placement decides a marriage. Astrologers also look at the seventh lord, Jupiter, the navamsa chart and the periods you are running.

faq.q: What is the difference between this and Venus passing through my house of partners now?
faq.a: Your birth chart shows where Venus was when you were born, and that never changes. The sky changes all the time: a transit is a passing season, read from your Moon sign.

note: House meanings are those of the classical Parashari tradition, with whole-sign houses. Venus’s position is calculated with the Lahiri ayanamsa; dates are US Eastern time.
